settings.text: Quick answers about orders, delivery, returns, sizing and authenticity. Can’t find yours? We’re happy to help.

settings.heading: How do I pay?
settings.row_content: We accept prepaid orders through our secure checkout: UPI, debit and credit cards, net banking and wallets.

settings.heading: Do you offer Cash on Delivery?
settings.row_content: No. All orders are prepaid. This keeps delivery fast and lets us insure every pair until it reaches you.

settings.heading: How do I know my order went through?
settings.row_content: You receive an order confirmation email straight after checkout. If it isn’t in your inbox, check your spam folder or write to support@evlvex.in.

settings.heading: Can I cancel or change my order?
settings.row_content: Yes, free of charge until it is dispatched. Email support@evlvex.in with your order number. After dispatch, you can return the pair once it arrives.

settings.heading: How much does shipping cost?
settings.row_content: Shipping is free on every order across India.

settings.heading: How long does delivery take?
settings.row_content: We dispatch within 1–2 working days. Delivery usually takes 3–7 working days after dispatch, depending on your pin code. Remote areas can take a little longer.

settings.heading: How do I track my order?
settings.row_content: When your order ships, we email you (and send an SMS where available) with the courier name and a tracking link. See Track your order.

settings.heading: Do you ship outside India?
settings.row_content: Not yet. We currently ship to addresses in India only.

settings.heading: What is your return policy?
settings.row_content: You can return a pair or exchange it for another size within 7 days of delivery. It must be unworn, in its numbered box with the dust bag and certificate tag.

settings.heading: How do I start a return or exchange?
settings.row_content: Email support@evlvex.in with your order number and tell us whether you want a refund or another size. We arrange a free pickup from your address.

settings.heading: When will I get my refund?
settings.row_content: Within 5–7 working days after the pair reaches us and passes inspection, to your original payment method.

settings.heading: My pair arrived damaged or wrong. What now?
settings.row_content: Tell us within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the pair and the box. We collect it free and replace it or refund you in full.

settings.heading: What size should I order?
settings.row_content: Our shoes run true to standard Indian/UK sizing: select your normal UK size. Women: choose the UK size that is 2 below your Women's US size (Women's US 8 = UK 6). See the size guide for EU, US and foot-length conversions.

settings.heading: What if the size doesn’t fit?
settings.row_content: Exchange it for another size within 7 days of delivery. Pickup is free.

settings.heading: How do I care for my pair?
settings.row_content: Wipe the smooth panels with a soft, dry cloth, brush the textured overlays gently in one direction, and let your pair dry away from direct heat. Full instructions are in our care guide.

settings.heading: What is the QR tag inside my shoe?
settings.row_content: Every EvlveX pair has a numbered QR tag. Scan it to open the pair’s certificate page, which confirms it is genuine.

settings.heading: How do I check a pair is genuine?
settings.row_content: Scan the tag, or enter its serial number on our Authenticity page. evlvex.in is the only official EvlveX store.

settings.heading: Can I change or hide the name on my certificate?
settings.row_content: Yes. Write to support@evlvex.in and we will change it, show initials only or remove it.

settings.heading: Where are EvlveX shoes made?
settings.row_content: Every EvlveX model is an original design, made in India. Every pair is inspected before it is packed and leaves us with its numbered QR certificate.

settings.heading: Will COMEBACK be restocked?
settings.row_content: COMEBACK is made in a limited, numbered run, and we have no restock planned. If we ever make it again, it will be a new numbered run, and newsletter subscribers will hear first.

settings.text: Write to support@evlvex.in or message us on Instagram, @evlvex. We answer within one working day.
